steps.content: Explain yourself. Why did you do that?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Hmm... Does it matter?
You give no response, but simply activate the big screen and press the play button on the security footage.
You turn on the lights while you're at it. In the footage, Dolly constantly swings her baseball bat at the Corruptors in front of her.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: What's wrong with that? I'm just carrying out a mission.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Now if you wrongly accuse me, you'll have to compensate me with an Eastside baseball poster!
You ignore Dolly and keep pressing the fast-forward button.
An explosion occurs, and the smoke completely blocks the camera.
The smoke gradually dissipates, and an angry Dolly charges at you with a roar, as if she regards you as her enemy.
You press the pause button.

options: Do you not want to explain?
I guess you're not wrongly accused at all.

choices.text: Do you not want to explain?
I guess you're not wrongly accused at all.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Ugh. To be honest, I'm a little bit disappointed in you.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: You talk exactly like those FAC guys.
Forget about that. How did you answer them?
I don't think this is a stupid question, by the way.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I just said I went out of control. They even took the opportunity to give me a full examination.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: See? I'm back here now because they <color=#fb9259>did not find any problems</color>.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: And now you made me sit here... Are you questioning the FAC's decision? Hmm?
Dolly, with her hands folded, has an attitude of "I'll see what you're gonna do with me" written all over her face.
The FAC's decision is obviously non-disputable, but Dolly's behavior in the mission was so peculiar that you even pulled out Dolly's FAC training records for comparison.
Your power is so strong that you can even break free from the "shackles" when I get off guard.
Combined with the FAC survey report, I believe... Your ability is stronger than that.
test
test
test
test
test
test
"Findings on the ability of Dolly the Sinner"
Based on the records and the thirty MBCC adaptation training, it is discovered that Dolly the Sinner has the "Berserk" ability.

However, she becomes unconscious in the Berserk state. The Sinner in such a state performs destructive actions on all surrounding objects, with only the Chief of the Bureau's ability able to get her out of the state.
Upon analysis, it is confirmed that the Berserk state of Dolly the Sinner is most directly related to the feeling of her safety being threatened.
In this "battle" state, Dolly instinctively protects herself with her ability.

In the MBCC venue, we tried to quantify her abilities with combat devices. The initial tests were very successful, but all the testing robots were destroyed. It is expected that a new round of tests can be carried out next week.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Pfft! That's it? More pointless tests for me?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Listen. My ability only went out of control because I got too emotional, not because of some threat to my safety.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: The mission site was so close to the Eastside baseball stadium. I lost my consciousness just hearing the sound of the crowd chanting.
In that case, why did the FAC not write the report according to the descriptions of the subject Sinner?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Simple. I'm a Syndican. They didn't think I was telling the truth.

options: You seem to have a bias against FAC.

choices.text: You seem to have a bias against FAC.

steps.content: The FAC never makes judgments this subjective.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Hah... Have they not? They beat me back then, but luckily I was strong enough to take them all down.
Why were you involved with the FAC? You were in Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Well... I...

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I... accidentally hurt an Eastsider.
Then it should've been taken care of by the sheriffs in Syndicate. What has it got to do with the FAC?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: The sheriffs in Syndicate couldn't defeat me.
But the ones in Eastside could?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: E-Eastside? No... No, they were directly under the FAC.
Her lies are full of contradictions, but what baffles you is why she has to make up such lies.
You take out a piece of news back then.
test
test
test
test
test
test
test
On September 13 at 9:30 am, the biennial DIS Professional Baseball League was held at the Eastside Stadium. The opening game was between the Fountons and the Highlanders.
The Fountons' scores were behind, and their seed, Dolly, was underperforming. 33 minutes in the game, there was a violent beating incident.

Dolly, from the Fountons, got involved in a conflict with Haliaka from the Highlanders 
and punched her, sending the game into chaos.
Fortunately, the FAC members stationed in the venue arrived in time, bringing the situation under control and restoring order in the stadium.
However, due to the disruption, temporary venue maintenance was needed, delaying the following games by one day.
The game between the two teams will be rescheduled to next week. The player Dolly was sent off and will receive a lifetime ban.

According to the news, when you were playing baseball in Eastside, you punched a player on the opposing team and the FAC who were there to maintain order. But nothing is mentioned about anyone beating you up.
With each sentence you read, Dolly buries her face lower and lower.
So why did you say the FAC beat you?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: It's because... because!
Dolly's face becomes completely red.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Urgh, kill me!... Because if I didn't say that, I wouldn't even be able to go back to Syndicate! I have no choice but to say it's a reaction triggered by being beaten up!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I came all the way from Syndicate to Eastside for this game. And even risked violating that damned West District Regulations!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: The FAC found out who I was in the middle of the game, so they tried to pause the game and take me away. I definitely wouldn't let them!

options: You actually managed to beat them up?

choices.text: You actually managed to beat them up?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Of course, I beat them up the first time I activated my ability. Pretty impressive, right?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I was thinking like, "Even if they're arresting me, they'll have to wait until this game's done." And the thought gave me strength.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: My "emotion" enabled me to knock them all out of the way just with that baseball bat.
Your emotions add so much power to your abilities?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Chief, just put yourself in my shoes.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: It's your first time on the stage of your dreams. All the spectators are cheering for you. When you're about to get ahead of the other team, someone comes over and tells you to leave the field. Aren't you gonna be mad?
And then you fled back to Syndicate, saying that the FAC members beat you up and disqualified you from baseball games?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Humph... That was my first time using my ability, so I couldn't quite control myself.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: If I can still play in the games... I'll definitely be able to control myself and I won't let those FAC guys find out!
If it weren't for me, you might have been treated as a Corruptor and got shot down by the FAC today.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: ...Humph.
In the face of your scolding, Dolly goes silent.
Is emotion really the cause for Dolly going out of control? Did the FAC really make a mistake in their investigation?
Your shackles never had any issues, yet she broke free from your control today.
What in the world went wrong... Could it be the battle process?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Gosh. Do you have any more questions or not?!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: If not, let me go. I haven't practiced my bat swinging today!
Dolly seems impatient. Her iconic bat sits in a corner of the room. It certainly made its mark in her conflict with the FAC. But... Dolly doesn't fight with it very often.
You want to ask Dolly about this one more possibility.

options: Do you often fight with a baseball bat?

choices.text: Do you often fight with a baseball bat?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: What made you ask?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Not really. Some Corruptors simply don't deserve it. Fists are the most direct weapon in Syndicate.
And you didn't use your baseball bat in those thirty tests either?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Of course not. I didn't want to break the testing device and cause trouble for you guys.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: But those things seem to be even less sturdy than I thought.

options: And you practice your swing every day, right?

choices.text: And you practice your swing every day, right?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I've been preparing for the Eastside Baseball League all along.
How do you feel when you swing the bat?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: How do I feel? Does the anxiety of wanting a game count?
Seems like the ban has a really big impact on you.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: The ban is on Dolly as a Sinner. What does it have to do with Dolly the baseball player? You'll help me, right, Chief?
Be serious. I'm asking you a serious question here.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I am being serious here! I honestly really want to go back and play baseball games again!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Can you just do me a favor and fight for a chance for me, Chief?! If you're concerned or anything, just stand by there and watch me with those shackles of yours!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I promise, I'll definitely be able to control myself!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Gosh... How petty of you.
According to my analysis, you won't have much of a chance to play baseball on the field anymore.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Well, you never came across... as someone who likes to joke around like this... Hahaha.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Come on now, Chief, be honest... Do you not want to help me?
You're not a baseball player. You're a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Ha... Hahaha... I've heard this too many times.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I told you, I'll be able to control myself if you are there with me!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Right? Don't you think? Well, shouldn't it be super easy for you? You must've got distracted today, that's all. It's okay... I totally get it.
I was doing my best with your shackles today.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Well, you were just not feeling your best then! Come on... It happens to everyone! Look at me, I don't get to hit a home run every time either.
I honestly do not think you will ever be able to play in baseball games again.
I am sorry. There's nothing I can do to help you.
I am being serious. You... will probably never be able to play in baseball games again.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Now I'm really getting mad if you keep saying things like this.
It's not that I don't want to help you. I'm simply not able to help. Look at this.
test
test
test
test
test
test
You head toward the corner and show her the broken bat.
The metal bat was squeezed by external forces and eventually snapped in two.
The surface where it snapped is stained with Corruptors' blood, and the bat is covered with pits from the blows.
The reason why you went manic must have something to do with this.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: ...Is this some kind of lame joke? And I'm supposed to play along with you or something?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Don't be silly. It's not like I haven't played baseball after my ability got awakened.

options: I don't deny your point from earlier.

choices.text: I don't deny your point from earlier.

steps.content: No one knows you better than yourself.
But you don't seem to have fought much with this bat. You usually reserved it for those you subconsciously believe to be the "strongest enemies."
Am I right?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Yep—
As far as I can see, your ability isn't just related to emotions.
It has more to do with this.
You swing the bat in your hand.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Gosh... now can you stop being ridiculous. It isn't even funny anymore.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I always start my batting practice after practicing my swing, and I've never got into the same state as I did today.
How about this? Let's make a bet.
If you win, I'll get you in the Eastside baseball stadium and let you play a baseball game all you like.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: What the hell...

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Wait... Qualification for the Eastside Baseball League?!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Are you serious?!
Of course, but only if you do as I say.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: But no strange requests.
You will come with me on the next mission at the Rust.
Oh wait.
Remember to bring your baseball bat.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: ...That's it?
That's it. It's just the weakest Corruptors. You might not even need to use your ability.
"Emotion" is only one of the triggers for Dolly's ability. All the uncontrollable situations involved that one bat.
In the Eastside baseball stadium, she knocked down countless FAC members with the bat. During the mission, this same bat allowed her to break free from your shackles.
Without the bat, she's no more than a more explosive and less obedient Sinner.
You believe that the secret lies behind this bat.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Hahahahaha! Why don't you just give me the ticket? This mission is so easy that even those FAC rookies can do it.
You sigh as you watch Dolly getting smugger.
Of course, you will have to wait in the cell for the few days before this mission.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: The cell?! Isn't... Isn't it only for Sinners who've made serious mistakes...?
So attacking the MBCC Chief is a small mistake?
Nightingale will take you there.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Can I bring my bat?
No. No weapons are allowed in the cell.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: But I just want to practice...

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Tsk... I'm gonna teach you a lesson... You wait till I come out...

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: You're just an MBCC Chief... Just a Chief!
You leave the interrogation room with Dolly gritting her teeth in her seat.
